Thanks for moving quickly on the redlines. Acme confirmed they can sign the MSA and the Order Form in sequence but we need to lock down:

- Exact signer roles (who signs which doc)
- DocuSign routing order (sequential vs parallel)
- Any authentication requirements (SMS? ID check?)

Attached is a simple routing sheet I put together to make the envelope config explicit (Execution_Routing_Sheet.xlsx).

Can legal ops confirm that Laura has signatory authority for Order Forms under $500k? Marcus — can you call out the DocuSign settings you want (authentication, reminders, sequential routing)?

If Acme needs PO/PO number we should capture it now so we pre-fill the Order Form.

Thanks,
Mina

All —

Quick notes for the envelope configuration:

- Routing: sequential (MSA -> Acme VP Legal -> Redwood legal ops review -> Order Form -> Acme CFO -> Redwood VP Sales).
- Authentication: email-only for Acme is fine per Gina; set optional SMS for Redwood signers.
- Reminders: disable auto-reminders to avoid spamming the CFO; we'll send a reminder manually if needed.
- Signer fields: pre-placed signature and date fields on both documents, plus a text field on the Order Form for PO# (ACME-98765).
- Allow in-person signing if the signer requests it (set fallback to in-person).

Attaching a quick PDF that shows the tag map I used to pre-place fields: docusign-envelope-settings.pdf

Let me know if legal ops want anything else. Once Mina confirms, I'll queue the envelope but will hold sending until Gina confirms she wants the envelope tomorrow AM.

– Marcus
